scope: Reuse candidates and current limits; future-stage capabilities are not certified by source inspection.

present: CanvasItem positions use DVec2 and dimensions use Vec2.
CanvasView applies camera-relative center and zoom to logical pixels; MIN_ZOOM=0.0001 and MAX_ZOOM=3.
Spatial adds elevation, quaternion rotation and depth; flat and perspective views share native canvas items.
Presentation subtracts the current view origin before converting placements to f32.
limits: There is no declared physical conversion between a canvas unit and a metre.
A camera-relative renderer does not yet establish nested high-precision durable frames or independent huge-scale addressability.
Current zoom/depth/provider limits are implementation limits, not future scene scale levels.

present: WorkspaceStep uses an 8333333 ns fixed step and bounds catch-up to eight ticks per update.
Existing bodies use workspace/root collision isolation and explicit held/sleeping state.
MotionTimer blocks while inactive and rings the existing WakeSignal during active motion.
Existing spatial gravity contributes -981 canvas units per second squared for the current body conventions; this is not declared SI calibration.
Areas already supply supported influence/filter/immunity behavior, targets and 3D participation.
TopologyEffect and SpatialBinding already represent formula/preset sources and fixed/cursor/camera/item attachment.
Terrain has bounded tile generation and source revision/preview behavior.
limits: Motion settling is computational sleep, not thermodynamic cooling.
Current height-based floor effects do not represent arbitrary cave/overhang geometry.
Existing bounds and binding validity limits must be bridged deliberately to future local frames.
No new physical-material, molecular or continuum solver is required for Stage 01.
families.runtime_status: passed for the selected native Area/gravity/settling/isolation replay, not every Area configuration or future domain

present: Native workspace persistence retains accepted canvas state and saved revision information through a bounded writer.
Hosted workspace protocol/schema 2 has validated client declarations, typed operations, expected revisions, proposals/reviews, drafts and history.
Existing workspace/Record policy and audience checks own acceptance; authenticated source sessions remain separate.
Existing live transport tests cover signed edits, retries, reconnect and revocation.
limits: Current hosted layout is not a sparse model document format or a workspace-scoped arbitrary asset server.
Existing targeted tests verify current acceptance/permissions/transport limits; they do not certify sparse-model workloads.
Restricted anonymous/public visitor admission and sparse entry cost enforcement are future extensions.
Trusted-local None authority must not become a guest principal.

present: ResourceSnapshot reports retained payloads, managed surfaces, font atlases and selected graphics device.
The native surface allocator has a shared pixel/byte budget and demand-sensitive residency.
WakeSignal can be wrapped by the baseline observer without changing application wake semantics.
Person/Agent Record identity and delegated Fiote conversations already exist.
Fiote activation explicitly rejects borrowing local automation authority through shared workspace/Record grants.
Filesystem workspace tools and native component composition are separate existing capabilities.
limits: Managed texture estimates do not prove total GPU residency or per-Sand GPU/CPU time.
The existing flat-body resource counter alone does not count every spatial Body; the baseline samples spatial bodies explicitly.
Existing Fiote tools do not certify all future model operations, semantic context or native/Agent parity.
Model execution remains outside native edit transactions and startup.

present: The original MIT-licensed lynx has a skin/rig and authored activity clips.
Existing native code handles static/animated preferences, reduced motion, visibility/occlusion, animation state and residency.
cargo xtask maintenance fiote validate inspects actual mesh, weights, samples and loop seams.
limits: A conversational portrait/activity loop is not a completed shared character/rig editor or third-person controller.
The lynx has no claimed human anatomical coverage.
Optional human reference datasets require their own coverage/rights/admission decision in Stage 11.

present: Existing scenarios validate bounded inputs and use isolated Cell execution.
The native Laboratory has explicit temporary owner/access isolation.
limits: Operational scenarios do not provide molecular, thermal, rigid or continuum scientific validity.
No scientific worker is launched by fixture inspection or ordinary baseline canvas use; native storage and physics wake threads remain separately observable.
Future numerical datasets/protocols/error limits remain with their deferred owning stages.
